categories.name: Flaunch Ecosystem
categories.content: Flaunch Ecosystem consists of tokens launched via flaunch.gg.

categories.name: ERC 404
categories.content: ERC-404 is an experimental token standard that aims to bridge fungible tokens and NFTs to enable liquidity and fractionalization.

categories.name: Tokenized Non-US Government Securities
categories.content: Tokenized Non-US Government Securities are RWAs that digitalize sovereign debt instruments and international money market funds outside of the United States such as German Bunds, UK Gilts, and sovereign-backed cash equivalents, to provide diversified international yield and institutional collateral on-chain.

categories.name: Etherfuse Ecosystem
categories.content: Tokenized sovereign debt (Stablebonds) issued by Etherfuse in compliance of CNBV regulation.

categories.name: Zodiac-Themed
categories.content: Meme coins related to zodiac signs.

categories.name: Coinbase Ecosystem
categories.content: Tokenized U.S. equities issued by Coinbase and deployed on Base under its B20 tokenized equity standard, launched in 2026 for non-U.S. customers. Tokens are identified by a "C" suffix appended to the underlying ticker and can be traded onchain on DEXs.

categories.name: CreatorBid Ecosystem
categories.content: CreatorBid Ecosystem consists of tokens launched via creator.bid.

categories.name: Prediction Markets
categories.content: A crypto prediction market is a marketplace where people can bet on the outcome of future events using crypto.

categories.name: Pons Launchpad
categories.content: Tokens launched on pons (https://ponsfamily.com/launchpad).

categories.name: Pools Launchpad
categories.content: Tokens launched through Pools (https://pools.trade/), Uniswap's first-party token issuance platform.

categories.name: Options
categories.content: Options refer to financial instruments that give holders the right, but not the obligation, to buy or sell a cryptocurrency at a predetermined price, known as the strike price, before a specific date, known as the expiry date.

categories.name: Gambling (GambleFi)
categories.content: GambleFi refers to decentralized gambling platforms and tokens leveraging blockchain technology and smart contracts.

categories.name: Bitcoin Meme
categories.content: Meme coins native to the Bitcoin network.

categories.name: Runes
categories.content: Runes is a token standard on Bitcoin that improve the creation of fungible tokens on the blockchain.

categories.name: Stock market-themed
categories.content: Meme coins related to the stock market.

categories.name: Bridged-Tokens
categories.content: Bridged-tokens refers to a token that has been transferred or "bridged" from one blockchain to another, typically through the use of a blockchain bridge.

categories.name: Dinari Ecosystem
categories.content: The Dinari Ecosystem comprises tokens tokenized by Dinari.

categories.name: Buidlpad Launchpad
categories.content: Buidlpad is a launchpad that enables token sales with KYC-verified participants.

categories.name: Murad Picks
categories.content: Tokens promoted by a memecoin KOL @MustStopMurad.

categories.name: Tokenized Exchange-Traded Funds (ETFs)
categories.content: Tokenized Exchange-Traded Funds (ETFs) refers to digital representation of exchange-traded funds such as SPY, GLD, TQQQ, XLK, VXUS on a blockchain platform.
